claim: date::year_month_day_last::day() returns the Gregorian month length from a fixed table 31,28,31,30,31,30,31,31,30,31,30,31, substituting 29 for February exactly when date::year::is_leap(), which is y % 4 == 0 && (y % 100 != 0 || y % 400 == 0); so 2000-02-29 is valid and 1900-02-29 and 2100-02-29 are not.
